newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sueno Kosan units declared bankrupt - Japan court.
newsitem.headline: Sueno Kosan units declared bankrupt - Japan court.

text.p: Four group companies of Sueno Kosan, a major borrower from failed "jusen" mortgage firms, have been declared bankrupt, the Osaka District Court said on Friday.
The court did not elaborate further.
Private research company Teikoku Databank Ltd said in a statement that the debts of the four companies total 107 billion yen.
Sueno Kosan itself was declared bankrupt by the Osaka District Court in November last year with debts of about 700 billion yen.
